What is problematic around the GDPR is not the regulation itself, but the market’s habit of replacing factual analysis with a universal threat. A cookie banner in Germany is not required “by default,” but only when technologies that require consent are in use. When that distinction is erased, what is being sold is no longer compliance, but anxiety. What matters is not the scandal, but the criterion: how do you distinguish a good-faith explanation from fear used as a commercial tool? #GDPR #WebCompliance #SEO
